content: The tongue is only three inches long, yet it can bring down a seven-foot warrior.
author: Japanese Proverbs
sourceWork: Shita wa wazawai no moto (舌は災いの元)
explanation: A sword can only wound what is immediately before it, but a reckless word spoken in haste can destroy reputations, sever twenty-year friendships, and ignite wars across generations. Guard the gateway of your lips as if your life depended on it.
practicalInsight: Count to three before answering any provocative statement today. Ensure your words heal rather than wound.
reflectionPrompt: What careless sentence from your past do you wish you could recall, and what does that teach you about speaking today?
